data.title: Duke Energy prepares for Isaias' rain and wind, encourages customers in SC Upstate and NC mountains to get ready
data.description: Duke Energy in Charlotte, N.C. is gearing up to address probable damage and power outages in the Carolinas following the aftermath of Hurricane Isaias. Even though projections indicate that Isaias is likely to track to the west of the Carolinas, concerns remain for the eastern part of the region. The company is setting up response plans to manage any potential impacts on power supply and infrastructure due to the hurricane.

data.title: KBRA Assigns AA+ Rating to Borough of North Slope, Alaska General Obligation Bonds, Series 2026; Affirms Rating for Parity Bonds
data.description: In a recent announcement, credit rating agency KBRA has assigned a long-term rating of AA+ to the Borough of North Slope, Alaska General Obligation Bonds, Series 2026. Concurrently, KBRA has affirmed the long-term rating of AA+ for the Borough's existing General Obligation Bonds, with a Stable Outlook. The ratings are based on positive factors including the Borough's history of prudent budget management, supported by strong financial management practices. These ratings indicate a high level of creditworthiness for the Borough, positioning it favorably in the bond market.
